newsitem.title: INDIA: Cyclone expected to hit India's Gujarat.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone expected to hit India's Gujarat.

text.p: Indian weather forecasters said a cyclone is expected to hit the coast of Gujarat state Friday afternoon, bringing heavy rain and winds of 50 kph and 60 kph to nearby Bombay.
The cyclone was originally forecast to hit the coast Thursday night but then slowed down over the Arabian Sea, the India Meteorological Department said in a statement.
The cyclone is about 200 km off India's western coast.
"It is likely to move in a northerly direction and cross the Gujarat coast between Bhavnagar and Porbandar close to Veraval by afternoon of today," the statement said.
The three towns are minor ports located on the south Gujarat coast, about 330 km northwest of Bombay.
Bombay is located in neighbouring Maharashtra state.
Weather bureau officials in Bombay said the city can expect the bad weather to continue until late Friday.
Fishermen have been warned to stay in port during the next 24 hours, they said.
